I've attached a photo so you can easily recognize him when you arrive (he's the one in blue 😊👍) …
Excellent professionals and top-notch service, don't hesitate to bring your pet.
Professionals in the care of your pets.

From the moment I met María José and her team at Camoix Veterinary Clinic, I knew I had found an exceptional place for Kurama's care. María José stands out not only for her professionalism and warmth but also for her deep empathy towards animals. Every visit to the clinic is a positive experience, where you can feel the respect and dedication that she and her team have for each patient.

The care she provides is unparalleled; she treats each animal as if it were part of her own family, ensuring they feel comfortable and safe. Her knowledge and skills are evident in every consultation, giving me great peace of mind knowing that my dog ​​is in the best hands.

I cannot recommend María José and Camoix Clinic highly enough. If you are looking for a place where your animals are treated with love and professionalism, this is the place to be.

The service was adequate during regular hours. However, if you call them with an emergency and have to wait 5 minutes, even if you live near the clinic, they simply won't see you. They'll give you an appointment for the next day or whenever they have an opening, regardless of whether it's an emergency, and if not, they'll suggest you go somewhere else. This is exactly what happened to me, despite knowing me and being a long-time customer. They showed a complete lack of empathy for the animal and the owner. Purely about making money. I absolutely do not recommend them.

My name isn't on your records because it was my daughter's dog. As of today, December 5, 2025, it's been a little over two months. When I called, I spoke with Cris, and I was present, which is why I'm writing this review. After repeatedly insisting to Cris that you please see her, saying it would only take 5 minutes, Cris spoke with Mariajo, whom we overheard talking in the background. The conclusion was that there was no way; they would see her the next day at 11:30, or by then it would be Monday. This was an emergency; words fail me.

I also didn't think they were ashamed to respond to what happened, much less with lies, if we're talking about the same case. My daughter called at 6:00 PM; she lives next door to the clinic. They never called to check on the animal, as she claims. It's better to attend to an emergency in 5 minutes than to simply ignore it. Besides, any good professional will dedicate an extra 10 minutes to their patient if necessary, whether it's a person or an animal. And when she said it was an emergency, it was because it truly was urgent that the animal be seen. I'm not writing this review based on a subjective opinion; I'm writing it based on the reality of whoever was present. To be clear, and to summarize for anyone who finds this review helpful and doesn't have to go through the same thing, their professionalism and empathy are terrible in critical moments; they're adequate in day-to-day matters, but they're not there when you really need them.

We were recommended this clinic and I couldn't be happier. Today we took our dog Mia (a German Shepherd) there for the second time, and the care, dedication, and compassion they provide are priceless. Everyone on the clinic team is incredibly kind, starting with M José and Pau and the assistants. They take their time, explain the problem thoroughly, and you don't even realize how bad things might seem. I've found my go-to vet and I highly recommend them. Thank you so much, Pau and M José, for the wonderful care.

Simply the best! Our Chihuahua hurt her paw. Dr. María José treated her immediately. Humane, efficient, kind, respectful, and loving care for the animals. Thank you so much to Dr. Zamora and Cristiana. You are now our veterinarians.

It's not our usual vet, but we found a stray dog ​​in the area and took her in to have her microchip checked. The service was incredible, and while we were there waiting for the owner, we saw how they treated the dogs. Wonderful. It's a bit far, otherwise they'd be our regular vets.

I'm delighted with the clinic. I've been going there for years; my little one is treated wonderfully. María José, Pau, and Cristina are great professionals. I wouldn't change their clinic for anything in the world.
The vets are incredibly attentive. We took our two kittens there and they were so kind to them.
Super friendly, great service. I recommend it.
I went today for the first time with my cat and I loved the service and professionalism. They took plenty of time to attend to me too; I felt very welcome.
Excellent service
They're always willing to help, plus the clinic's hours are super long and they don't close at midday: spectacular recognition!

I wouldn't trade them for anything. They always treat us with joy and love, and as pet owners, I think that's the least we can ask for. Trustworthy, clear in their explanations and diagnoses, and very helpful. Thank you! 🫶🏼 …

The best experience we've had with our little ones. They helped us with everything we went through with them in Valencia, from health issues to travel documents, with a dedication, care, and attention that you don't find everywhere.
Excellent professionals 🐈🐈‍⬛. Thank you so much! …

Truly the nicest vet that I have met in 30 years of dog ownership! Such kind and friendly people. Very clean clinic and the owners are passionate about dogs and highly knowledgeable. Thankfully for me Pau also speaks excellent English. Highly recommended.

I took my 2 dogs after arriving from Medellin, Colombia.  They helped with getting the leishmania vaccine and Euro pet passport.  What a great husband and wife team super friendly and knowledgeable.  Definitely recommend 💯 …
Super happy with the treatment of animals and people, true professionals, highly recommended.
Very attentive and a kind and caring treatment to pets
It's not the same veterinary clinic it used to be... it leaves much to be desired. What a shame!
